[B1] < UserX | 'key' : nils, ... > $ Cloud 'sendKey' UserX | Key

[B3] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, UserY, Rest), ...), ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' Cloud | (Device; UserY)

[B4] < cloudSmartThing | Device : ('key' : Key, 'on' : false, ...), ... > $ UserX 'turnOnWithKey' cloudSmartThing | (Device; Key)
=> < cloudSmartThing | Device : ('key' : Key, 'on' : true, ...), ... > $ cloudSmartThing 'turnOn' Device .
[B5] < Device | ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' Device

[B6] < Cloud | Device : ('on' : false, 'trusted' : (P, Rest), ...), ... > $ P 'turnOn' Device

[B7] < cloudSmartThing | Device : ('boundTo' : B, ...), ... > $ cloudSmartThing 'turnOn' Device
=> < cloudSmartThing | Device : ('boundTo' : B, ...), ... > $ cloudSmartThing 'turnOn' B .
[B8] < deviceLock | 'trusted' : (P, Rest), 'on' : false, ... > $ P 'turnOn' deviceLock
=> < deviceLock | 'trusted' : (P, Rest), 'on' : true, ... > .
